instructions: Manual findings apply only to reviewReferenceSha256. A changed reference makes them stale. All bounds are physical px, right/bottom exclusive. D implementation is compared with A original; no equivalence or similarity score is claimed.
reviewMethod: Actually viewed all three side-by-side and all three 50% overlays, then checked selected exact-RGB components and bounded dark-ink probes with Pillow.
